headline: OJK Drafting Rules Requiring Mini Banks to Upgrade Class
summary: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) plans to abolish the grouping of banks based on core capital of Rp3-6 trillion. The policy aims to strengthen the structure and efficiency of Indonesian banking.
why: The OJK is Indonesia's financial services regulator, and capital requirements determine which banks must merge, raise funds or upgrade their status.
original_headline: OJK Sedang Susun Aturan Bank Mini Wajib Naik Kelas
